pages.text: $(bold)Dual-edge$(reset): the stronger the upside, the more likely a numbered downside — pushing one stat up while shaving off survival or mobility.$(br2)$(bold)Roll rules:$(reset) each roll is benign : dual ≈ $(reset)7 : 3$(reset), and the tier-1 pool has no dual traits — risk only starts at tier 2.$(br2)$(bold)Carrying capacity:$(reset) trait slots = quality tier + 1 (I=1 / II=2 / III=3 / IV=4); higher-tier organs carry more mutations, dual included.$(br2)Unlock tiers still follow sequence purity: <60 sees tier 1 only, 60-84 tiers 1-2, 85+ all three. This entry lists all $(reset)12 dual traits$(reset).

pages.title: Tier 2 · Dual (4)
pages.text: $(bold)Strike$(reset)$(li)Berserker Gene: +2 attack, −1.5 armor as price$(li)Glass Bones: +0.8 attack speed, −2 max health$(li)Feral Surge: +2 attack & +0.6 attack speed, −2 max health$(br2)$(bold)Strike · Glide$(reset)$(li)Hypertrophy: +1.5 attack, −1.5% move speed$(br2)Tier-2 dual traits share one pattern: trade a portion of survival or mobility for a large damage increase — suited as damage amplifier pieces.

pages.title: Tier 3 · Dual (1/2)
pages.text: $(bold)Strike$(reset)$(li)Predator Instinct: +3 attack & +2% move, −4 max health$(li)Pyroblast Flesh: +3 attack, permanent fire weakness$(li)Adrenal Overdrive: +1.2 attack speed, −6 max health$(li)Nocturne Bone: +0.5 attack speed & +2% move, ignites under direct sunlight (Refractory Cells cancels it)

pages.title: Tier 3 · Dual (2/2)
pages.text: $(bold)Strike (cont.)$(reset)$(li)Glutton Muscle: +2 attack & +0.4 attack speed, hunger drains faster$(li)Fracture Strike: +2.5 attack & +0.3 attack speed, takes extra physical damage$(br2)$(bold)Ward$(reset)$(li)Juggernaut Core: +4 armor & +2 armor toughness, −2% move$(br2)$(bold)Mass$(reset)$(li)Gigantism: +8 max health, −2% move & −0.4 attack speed$(br2)Tier-3 dual traits carry the highest cost: besides health/armor costs, three additional cost axes — sun-burn, hyper-metabolism and fragile bones — make downsides non-uniform.

pages.title: Using dual traits
pages.text: $(bold)Recommended usage:$(reset)$(li)$(reset)In-place reroll$(reset) at the Trait Reforger — an unsatisfactory roll can be rerolled for crystals and life energy$(li)$(reset)While a breakthrough potion is active, negative-base traits are suspended$(reset) — the upside is kept without the downside; dual organs perform best in that window$(li)Gigantism-style "health-for-speed" trades pair well with regen passives to offset the cost$(br2)$(bold)Pitfalls:$(reset) stacking Berserker Gene and Predator Instinct on one low-survival organ drains armor and health simultaneously — dual traits also amplify each other's costs.
For the benign counterparts see Benign Trait Catalog; dual and benign roll from the same pool, unlocked by sequence purity — see Samples & Sequences. Reroll details are in The Secrets of Life.
